summary.text: Connie Lane is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack District 16 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. A lawyer by training, she has also served on the Merrimack County Commission.

paragraphs.text: Lane lives in Concord, New Hampshire, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a B.A. in political science and history from the University of Georgia in 1977 and a J.D. from the University of Virginia in 1980.
Her career experience includes working as a lawyer, as director of Orr & Reno and as executive director of the Legal Advice & Referral Center.
Lane has served on the board of directors of the New Hampshire Housing Finance Authority, as chair of the board of trustees of Red River Theatres, and on the Merrimack County Commission.
Ballotpedia lists her on the Election Law Committee from the 2019-2020 session through 2023-2024, and on the Special Committee on Redistricting in 2021-2022.
